name: orgforge
description: Run an AI-native IT company through a forced SDLC with guardrails that actually block: blast-radius caps reserved atomically in a hash-chained ledger, a gate and an adversarial skeptic, and every judgment recorded with its reasoning.

interface.shortDescription: Guardrails that block, on a hash-chained ledger
interface.longDescription: Projects orgforge's neutral guardrail layer onto Codex. A PreToolUse hook reserves blast-radius exposure atomically in an append-only, hash-chained ledger and denies a call whose reservation cannot be written — so only a decision that was recorded becomes an allow. Holds are recorded too, and a bypass that cannot be recorded is refused.
